### ✨ Punishing: Gray Raven (v4.8.2)
Pro Glass UI Mod Menu by **m0hammed** (`@m0hmm3d`) — supports both **Rootless (`arm64`)** and **RootHide (`arm64e`)**.

### 🔥 Mod Features
- **Enable Pro God Preset** — God Mode + 20x Damage + 100% Crit + Inf Dodge & Orbs
- **God Mode (Invincible)** — Player & Allies take 0 damage and cannot die
- **Defense Multiplier** — Reduces incoming damage & boosts player defense
- **1-Hit Kill Enemies** — Instantly defeats enemies on any hit
- **Damage Multiplier** — Multiplies all outgoing Physical, Elemental & True damage
- **Attack Stat Multiplier** — Multiplies base Physical & Elemental Attack stats
- **100% Critical Hit** — Guarantees critical hits on every attack
- **Infinite Dodge Energy** — Dodge gauge never depletes & instantly refills
- **Infinite Signature Energy** — 5x faster Signature Move energy & zero cost
- **Fast Signal Orbs (Instant Ping)** — Rapidly generates Signal Orbs on basic attacks
- **Max Partner / CUB Attack** — Boosts Partner / CUB attack & critical rate
- **Freeze Enemy HP (Training)** — Enemies take 0 HP loss for infinite combo practice
- **Weak Enemies (1 HP / 0 ATK)** — Newly spawned enemies initialize with 1 HP and 0 Attack
- **Reset Speed to 1.0x** — Restore normal game speed

### 🔒 License & Activation
- **1-User Device Lock**: Each token locks automatically to the first device that activates it.
- **Trial & Full Keys**: Supports `2h` trial keys, `30d` plans, and Lifetime keys.
- **Telegram Support & Keys**: Contact **@m0hmm3d** on Telegram.
